title: Stage 1 — Chapter 33 Enhanced Summary Rulings
eyebrow: Temple of Elemental Evil / Chapter 33 / staged consistency
lede: Three new judgments need rulings. Four mechanical corrections are already applied; five findings retain transcript-backed or previously approved rulings.
footer: Applied without asking: 4 mechanical finding corrections in session-summary.md—Zinnia’s pronouns, the false 44-HP maximum, Dren’s captain title, and the unsupported exclusive shield-use claim.

items.t: Change the remaining prisoner count from three to four to match the grounding documents?
items.y: Change both references in session-summary.md from three prisoners to four. This matches world_state.md and party.md but contradicts the GM’s explicit count during this session.
items.n: Leave session-summary.md at three prisoners, preserving the GM’s session ruling; the four-prisoner entries in the grounding documents will remain stale and require correction.
items.ev: The GM says three remain at GMT20260823-150221_Recording.transcript (1).cleaned.vtt:2157 and clarifies that one was freed and the other three remain at :2189. Grounding says four at docs/world_state.md:69 and docs/party.md:11. The recap references are session-summary.md:12 and :73.

items.t: Remove Calmer’s Ring of Evasion because it is absent from the party inventory?
items.y: Remove the Ring of Evasion references from the combat scene, Calmer NPC entry, and Items section of session-summary.md. This matches the current party inventory but discards an item the GM explicitly said Calmer had during combat.
items.n: Leave session-summary.md unchanged and preserve the table-established Ring of Evasion; the party inventory will remain incomplete and require an upstream addition.
items.ev: The GM explicitly says Calmer has a Ring of Evasion at GMT20260823-150221_Recording.transcript (1).cleaned.vtt:2913. The party inventory instead lists a Ring of Free Action at docs/party.md:20. Affected recap references are session-summary.md:91, :155, and :179.

items.t: Replace the table’s “fanatically lawful good” description of St. Cuthbert with a setting-neutral lawful characterization?
items.y: Change the parenthetical in session-summary.md to describe St. Cuthbert as a strongly lawful deity of discipline and retribution. This aligns better with standard Greyhawk lore but no longer reproduces the GM’s table explanation.
items.n: Leave session-summary.md unchanged, preserving the GM’s explicit table characterization even though it differs from common published alignment descriptions.
items.ev: The GM uses the exact ‘fanatically lawful good’ description at GMT20260823-150221_Recording.transcript (1).cleaned.vtt:1673. The recap repeats it at session-summary.md:55.
